data.review_title: Defective Products, Terrible Quality Control & One of the Worst Return Experiences I've Ever Had!!
data.review_text:
I have spent over 10 hours, sent more than 50 emails, and travelled to six different return locations trying to return products that should never have been shipped in the first place.

The reason for my return wasn't that I changed my mind.
The clothing arrived with incorrect sizing, poor workmanship, unfinished construction, and obvious quality issues. Some items looked like they had never been properly finished before being packaged. The sizing was nowhere close to what was advertised, making several items completely unwearable. These are quality control failures that fall entirely on SHEIN.
Instead of standing behind the products they sell, SHEIN leaves customers to deal with the consequences.

The customer service has been just as disappointing as the products. After more than 50 emails, I continue receiving the same generic copy-and-paste responses that completely ignore the concerns I've raised. Not once has anyone meaningfully addressed the poor quality of the items, the incorrect sizing, or the countless hours I've spent trying to return them.
The biggest issue has been SHEIN's return process in Toronto.

I previously completed a SHEIN return while I was in Vancouver, where the return was handled through Canada Post. It was simple, professional, and took only a few minutes. That's exactly how a return process should work.My experience in Toronto has been the complete opposite.

SHEIN uses a third-party return network that has been an absolute nightmare. I have been sent from location to location, only to find businesses that were closed, difficult to access, or operating with extremely limited hours. One designated return location had nothing more than a handwritten piece of paper taped to the door listing its business hours. I took photographs because I couldn't believe a company the size of SHEIN expects customers to rely on a return network operating like this.
I work full-time and don't permanently live in Toronto. Spending days travelling across the city trying to return defective clothing is completely unreasonable. I've documented every trip, every location, walking directions, screenshots, emails, and photographs because I simply couldn't believe how difficult this process became.

No customer should have to spend weeks chasing down return locations because a company shipped merchandise that failed basic quality standards.

The most frustrating part is the complete lack of accountability. Instead of acknowledging the problems or offering a practical solution, SHEIN continues sending automated responses while the customer absorbs all of the time, inconvenience, and expense.

A return policy is supposed to protect customers when products arrive defective or not as described. It should not become a second job.

If SHEIN can provide a simple, efficient return process through Canada Post in one Canadian city, there is no reason customers in another city should be forced through such a disorganized and inaccessible third-party network.

This entire experience has shown me that once something goes wrong, customer service and accountability disappear. I expected far better from a global retailer.

I sincerely hope SHEIN reviews both its quality control and its Canadian return process because no customer should have to fight this hard to return products that should never have passed inspection in the first place.
I will not be shopping with SHEIN again, and I cannot recommend them based on this experience.

data.review_title: Missed delivery deadline, then extended it instead of honouring the promised refund
data.review_text:
Ordered from SHEIN with a stated delivery window of 23–27 July 2026. The parcel reached the destination airport and then sat there for six days with no tracking movement, and was never released to the local courier.

On 27 July, a customer service representative confirmed in writing, in the app chat, to reach out again the next day and request a full refund then if the order does not. It was not delivered.

I contacted customer service again on 28 July, as instructed. Rather than the promised refund as per the policy of missed ETA deadline, the delivery deadline was moved to 3 August without my agreement.

Customer service was polite throughout (although fully automated bot, not a human being in sight), but every reply repeated the same three points regardless of what I asked: an apology, a request to wait longer, and a note that intercepting the parcel "may fail."

There was no way to reach a supervisor or anyone able to approve a refund directly, and the only concrete option offered was to refuse a delivery that no courier had yet attempted.

I've kept screenshots of the original delivery window, the written refund commitment, and the later change of date, in case anyone from SHEIN wants to look into it.

All I received is a link with a tracking code to track the local courier. However, the package has not even been handed to the local courier and the customer support representative still keeps insisting to check with the courier.

What I'd flag for other buyers is what happens after a delivery date is missed: the promised refund process didn't hold up in my case. Be very careful and cautious. I'll update this review if that changes.

* The other customer’s packing slip that was inside my package.
* My original order showing what I purchased.
* Additional documentation proving the merchandise did not match my order.

Despite this, SHEIN repeatedly denied my claim, stating that their warehouse confirmed my package was shipped correctly. They have never explained how another customer’s packing slip ended up inside my package if there was supposedly no fulfillment error.

Rather than acknowledging that I never received the merchandise I paid for, I was simply told to return the package as if this were a standard return.

I have since had to file a dispute with Klarna, a complaint with the Better Business Bureau, and a report with the FTC because I have been unable to get SHEIN to address the evidence or issue a refund.

My biggest frustration is not just the fulfillment mistake—mistakes happen. It’s that even after providing clear documentation, including another customer’s packing slip, SHEIN refused to explain how that could happen while insisting there was no warehouse error.

I expected much better customer service and accountability.

data.review_title: Finger weg von SHEIN – Retoure nachweislich zugestellt, 875,96 € seit knapp 2 Monaten offen
data.review_text:
Ich laufe mittlerweile seit über zwei Monaten meiner Rückerstattung in Höhe von 875,96 € hinterher. Und nein – hier geht es nicht um ein paar Euro, sondern um eine sehr hohe Summe, auf die man als normaler Mensch angewiesen ist.

Es handelte sich um eine kombinierte Rücksendung, weil SHEIN selbst empfiehlt, mehrere Rücksendungen zusammenzufassen, um Versandkosten zu sparen. Genau das habe ich getan.

Ich habe meine Rücksendung ordnungsgemäß bei DHL abgegeben. Ich besitze den offiziellen Einlieferungsbeleg und die Sendungsverfolgung, aus der eindeutig hervorgeht, dass das Paket im Lager angekommen ist – inklusive Datum, Uhrzeit und Zustellung.

Trotzdem behauptet SHEIN seit Wochen immer wieder, die Retoure sei angeblich nicht im Lager eingetroffen. Egal welche Nachweise ich einreiche – ich bekomme jedes Mal dieselben Standardantworten. Niemand geht auf meinen konkreten Fall ein.

Nachdem ich angekündigt habe, rechtliche Schritte einzuleiten, verlangt SHEIN plötzlich Dinge wie Videomaterial vom Verpacken oder Einliefern der Retoure. Welcher normale Mensch filmt sich bitte dabei, wie er ein Paket verpackt oder zur DHL bringt? Außerdem soll ich einen Nachweis über das Paketgewicht liefern. Wie soll ich als Kunde an interne Gewichtsangaben kommen? Ich habe darauf überhaupt keinen Zugriff. Ich habe sogar mehrfach bei DHL angerufen. Selbst dort konnte man nicht nachvollziehen, warum trotz aller Nachweise immer weitere Forderungen gestellt werden.

Seit über zwei Monaten verbringe ich einen Großteil meiner Freizeit damit, E-Mails zu schreiben, zu telefonieren und immer wieder dieselben Unterlagen einzureichen. Es kostet unheimlich viel Zeit, Kraft und Nerven. Ich habe wirklich noch nie in meinem Leben einen derart frustrierenden Kundenservice erlebt.

Am Telefon fühlt sich niemand zuständig und per E-Mail erhält man immer wieder dieselben Standardtexte. Man hat das Gefühl, mit einer Wand zu sprechen.

Meine Verantwortung war es, das Paket ordnungsgemäß bei DHL abzugeben. Das habe ich getan. Ich kann nachweisen, dass es an der auf dem Retourenschein angegebenen Adresse zugestellt wurde. Was danach innerhalb des Unternehmens passiert, liegt nicht mehr in meiner Verantwortung.

Da ich auf normalem Weg nicht weiterkomme, habe ich inzwischen die Verbraucherzentrale informiert und einen Anwalt beauftragt, meine Ansprüche durchzusetzen. Ich werde den Fall notfalls gerichtlich klären lassen.

Diese Erfahrung hat mich psychisch enorm belastet. Niemand sollte wochenlang einer berechtigten Rückerstattung hinterherlaufen müssen, obwohl alle erforderlichen Nachweise vorliegen.

Für mich steht fest: Nie wieder SHEIN. Ich werde dort nie wieder bestellen und auch meiner Familie, meinen Freunden und meinem Bekanntenkreis davon abraten. Diese Erfahrung hat inzwischen jeder in meinem Umfeld mitbekommen und viele haben dadurch selbst Angst, dort zu bestellen. So sollte kein Unternehmen mit seinen Kunden umgehen.

Ich hoffe, dass meine Erfahrung andere Menschen davor bewahrt, dieselbe Situation erleben zu müssen.

This has been a very frustrating and poorly managed refund process. SHEIN should have respected the refund method I requested, or at least processed the refund correctly according to the original transaction.

data.review_text: Good day everyone I am a first time user on SheIn app as I was introduced by friend. I had to contact their customer agent who cancel the item and  the money was refunded to my shein wallet asked me to reorder as the claim the don't modify their orders.  Only to discover that I could no no longer order the item as a ridiculous shipping fee of 35000  naira had been added to an item of 4242 naira. I tried  pleading them to waive off the shipping fee as all the items were supposed to come together the refused and I had already paid the first amount the refused. The can't be trusted as their prices are not consistent with what is written in the app 🥺 I can't ever trust shein again . One Agent went as far cancelling all my orders with me asking him to do so
